To Our Members:
Ten years ago, in the spring of 2015, Navy Federal Credit Union had five million members and a 
global workforce of just over 12,000. It was then—as it is today—the world’s largest credit union.

Your Credit Improves. Your Rate Follows.
A shining example of how we return profits to our members, 
BECU’s Reprice Program turned 20 years old in 2025.
Here’s how it works: Each year, we review eligible accounts  
and automatically reduce interest rates for members who 
improved their credit scores and kept a strong payment history. 
Members may receive a rate reduction on auto, boat, RV and 
other consumer loans.
No applications or phone calls. We just do it. If your credit score 
dips later, your rate stays the same. It doesn’t go back up.
Last year, we repriced 46,603 member loans, helping those 
members save an estimated $2.24 million in interest. Over the 
past 20 years, we’ve repriced more than 650,000 loans and  
saved members an estimated $29 million in interest.1

label_method: Original 15 row-labeled NCUA questions plus 20 fact-labeled annual-report questions and 3 annual coverage negatives. Annual anchors and equivalent pages verified against physical PDF text before the final retrieval run. No tuning or result-based query selection. PDF facts can share a passage; all supported units count toward recall. Version 2 corrects equivalent-page labels and numeric boundaries before any scores were inspected.
timing_scope: Local warmed retrieval only; randomized configuration order within shuffled questions. No generation, network or UI latency.
limits: Exploratory, manually labeled convenience set. Questions share reports and institutions, so question-bootstrap intervals can overstate certainty. Not a held-out general benchmark. All evidence units in a retrieved passage count toward recall; MRR uses first matching passage. nDCG omitted because multi-fact passages require a separately specified gain model. The parser bugfix was motivated by known failures on these same questions; this is a regression evaluation, not an independent held-out test. No chunking hyperparameters or question labels were changed.
note: Original pre-OCR retrieved passages rescored under frozen version-3 labels. No new retrieval. Original results remain unchanged.
